method: python training/confirm_learning_curve.py --data-dir ml-32m The first learning-curve test (evaluate_love_and_learning.py) compared 10 choices with 3 and the interval crossed zero, so the app makes no such claim. Its curve kept rising to 50 choices. That pattern was seen on those viewers, so it can't be tested on them. It is tested here instead, on a separate 1-in-5 slice of MovieLens users (user ids ending differently from every earlier test), with both models rebuilt on that slice.
